sn19.10:1.1: Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakūtā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ kumbhaṇḍam purisaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ || || 2
sn19.10:1.2: So gacchanto pi teva aṇḍe khandhe āropetvā gacchati ||
sn19.10:1.4: Tam enam gijjha pi dhaṅkā pi kulalā pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti vibhajenti || ||
sn19.10:1.6: Eso bhikkhave satto imasmiññeva Rājagahe gāmakūṭo ahosi || ||
